Disclaimer: Despite the title, there are still depictions of nudity of the opposite sex, and of intersex or trans individuals. This disclaimer does not apply to every single image, but rather across all of the calendar galleries I'm posting as a whole. The title is merely what the official distributer refers to the calendar / pinup packs. If the sight of nudity of certain individuals makes for a less titillating experience for you, know that you have been warned.

The 2026 calendar Beast World calendar produced by Heartleaf Games. This includes the calendar proper(the title for each pinup are written in the calendar headers, and in later calendars short blurbs too), the holiday descriptions, the SFW pinups, and their NSFW counterparts. Unlike the 2024 and 2025 calendar packs, the 2026 calendar did not have a separate zip download for ONLY the SFW pinups, meaning the SFW versions are not the original resolutions.

The last image in the gallery is the list of the artists who provided the pinups. Whoever provided the art in the Beast World holiday descriptions is unknown to me (maybe I missed reading it somewhere?). These holiday descriptions are present in the 2025 and 2026 calendars too, but to my knowledge they are all identical, so I will not include them in those years' corresponding galleries.

In order to actually OBTAIN the digital packs for the calendars, a project must be active(in other words, purchases, even for the digital packs are not available year-round) and you have to make a pledge. If you want to get the older calendars, you need to go to the pledge add-ons tab and select the additional packs you want to include in your pledge rewards. You don't receive the rewards until about one month after the pledging period is over, but once you do, the digital rewards should be infinitely accessible to your backerkit account.

Listing the social media links of all the artists would be rather tedious, so I'm only listing the Heartleaf Games specific ones:
https://thedelversguide.com/ (Heartleaf Game's official website)
https://www.backerkit.com/c/users/1848193 (Where the calendars can be preordered and/or pledged)

Note: The pinups for April (both SFW and NSFW) had a work-in-progress version in the download packs instead of the finished version by accident. The backerkit site has since updated the packs with the correct, finished versions and removed the WIP versions. The ones with "fixed" in the file name (img #11 and 12) are the finished versions, and the two images following them (#13 and 14) are the WIP versions.
n: [Western] [Heartleaf games] (Various Artists) Ladies of the Beast World 2026 Feminine Calendar and Pinups (Read Disclaimer)
